Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying record retention provisions for county auditors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the retention of original claims by countyauditors; and amending RCW 36.22.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.22.070 and 1963 c 4 s 36.22.070 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((He)) (1) The auditor shall also retain all original bills andindorse thereon claimant's name, nature of claim, the action had, andif a warrant was issued, date and number the voucher or claim the sameas the warrant. (2) The auditor may retain all claims, bills, and associatedrecords referenced in subsection (1) of this section in an electronicformat sufficient for the conduct of official business. (3) For the purposes of this section, "claims" shall exclude claimsfiled against the county in accordance with the provisions of chapter4.96 RCW.
